scope: Local prequalification and controlled stage experiments; intermediate code identities are retained in each receipt. These observations do not close final whole-build, deployed load, lifecycle or Windy-host gates.
pathPolicy: Machine-specific repository and temporary path prefixes are replaced in data; originalSha256 identifies the untouched local source receipt.

data.archivePolicy: Compare every expected address, exact dimensions and decoded RGBA SHA256; archive ordering and compressed bytes may differ. Decoded content digest cache is bounded to 2,048 entries.

data.method: Existing pinned f003 offline renderer benchmark vs frozen1d78d1c baseline; Node22.23.4, M4Max; three separate16tile processes and one128tile process, eachfirstcold+5warm iterations alternatingbaseline/candidate. ExactRGBA hashes compared in everyrun. Sharedhost; localstage observation, not a CI completion claim.

data.note: Sequential variants, nonexclusive host. Cold means first operation; no OS cache purge. RSS is process-wide with shared acquisition and allocator history. Worker startup including shared input copy is excluded from raster runs and reported separately. Stage evidence only; no full-build resource claim.

Cold means first process operation; filesystem/OS caches were not purged. Archive mode uses a shared300KB cache to reproduce production eviction; exact decoded RGBA checked outside timings. Non-exclusive host; stage direction only, not a production speed claim.

pack.decision: adopt-direct-pack: exact bytes, retained-channel elimination, lower observed GC and process peak RSS

levels.decision: adopt-scratch: exact outputs and counted allocation-class elimination; timing change remains within observed range

limits: First operation is process-cold, not OS-cache-cold; no GC is forced.
GC durations count V8 events starting during measured operations, not necessarily full stop-the-world pause time.
RSS is the six-iteration process high-water, not per-iteration live memory or a complete-build bound.
Counted allocations cover only explicit input-level objects/arrays; heap snapshots and deltas do not measure total allocation.
Timing is one isolated process per case/variant with one cold operation and five warm operations; retain earlier distributions and full-build gate.

caveats: Dry parcel calculation; no moist parcel or cloud treatment.
Interval-mean surface fluxes are paired with the endpoint profile and PBL.
PBL may be missing unless the first resolved profile level is neutral or stable; that branch uses the smaller of its height and the PBL depth.
A profile without a resolved crossing is capped at its highest usable level and flagged.
MSL and model-AGL outputs share one column evaluation; model terrain is not a high-resolution terrain correction.
The adapter supplies liquid-water-equivalent rate for the declared trailing interval, including any accumulation differencing.
Negative, non-finite or explicitly missing rates are unavailable; no temporal interpolation is implied.

data.scope: Local workerd only; response cache disabled; 1MiB synthetic valid receipt with129groups×252 unique Unicode fields; 20bursts×32callers; all200responses hash checked. This samples allocated heap/backing/embedder memory; it does not fill every retained cache or prove deployed peak memory.
Local historical retained GFS on a frozen production-entrypoint bundle; prequalification only. This is not a deployed/current-source qualification or a universal memory bound.
data.archivePressurePrelude: One native-z7 coastal tile from each of the 24 frame/layer archives, at most 4 concurrent requests, before each run; receipts in *-archive-preload.json.
data.sampleGap: More than 180 seconds elapsed between warm load completion and uncached mode startup.
limitations: Allocated JS heap + backing storage + embedder heap sampled every 100 ms, no forced GC; native/unsampled peaks and deployed memory are not proven.
Final source has additional module extraction/shared JSON policy/failure cleanup and pending method descriptors; it requires fresh admission and deployed acceptance.
Cache pressure preloads every archive at one point; it does not fill every possible cache entry.
data.metadataRefreshNote: Warm response-cache hits still perform periodic retained-pointer refreshes: 19 small pointer reads occurred across the measured warm run.
